title: IBM invention award for my first patent application
summary: IBM gave me its First Patent Application Invention Achievement Award, signed by its chairman and CEO, for my availability invention.
what_i_did: Invented and filed 'Determining and Conveying User Availability'.
what_changed: Invention achievement award, December 2010; the patent was granted in 2013.
